title: Text to Image Generation and Editing: A Survey
measurement_description: The paper evaluates social biases and fairness in Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models, briefly noting how models generate biased images that reinforce Western stereotypes when given generic cultural prompts such as 'religious sites'.
findings: The survey notes that Text-to-Image generative models inadvertently learn and persist social biases from their training data. For instance, when the GLIDE model is prompted with generic cultural imagery such as 'religious sites', it tends to reinforce Western stereotypes in its generated images.
